# Amblyotube – Immersive Vision Training for Amblyopia

**Amblyotube** is a VR-based vision training app designed to support individuals with **amblyopia (lazy eye)**. Built for platforms like Meta Quest, it uses **dichoptic viewing** to deliver separate visual inputs to each eye, helping the brain improve **binocular vision** and depth perception.

The app allows users to select their lazy eye and automatically applies a **shader to the dominant eye** (reducing clarity via blur, brightness, or opacity) while enhancing the weaker eye using **AI-driven sharpening**. A unique **flicker stimulation** feature further activates the lazy eye by drawing the brain’s attention to key objects.

Amblyotube integrates **YouTube**, enabling users to watch their favorite content while training—making sessions engaging and consistent compared to traditional methods like patching.AmblyoTube plays video from the internet (including YouTube). A stable internet connection is required. Video is provided by third-party services; availability and terms are controlled by those services and may change.

Product Explainer: https://www.amblyotube.com/product-explainer/

Unlike full eye patching, Amblyotube promotes both eyes working together, improving coordination and spatial awareness. It is ideal for daily 30–40 minute sessions for users aged 13+.

**Note:** Amblyotube is an assistive training tool and does not replace medical treatment. Consult an eye care professional for guidance.
